messages:
kevin: Heads-up — deploying services/llmroute v4 to prod in a small-batch. Plan: feature/llmroute-v4 OFF -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with a hold at 50% for cache warmup. Pin v3 as immediate fallback. Preflight smoke tests passed. @maria please ack.

maria: ACK. CI smoke ✅, infra health ✅, and observability hooks wired into runbook. I added targeted evals for tokenization/latency.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 10% (canary-id: cb-8421). Links: https://console.redwood/obs/cb-8421 and logs: /deploys/8421.

maria: Canary metrics (10m): p50 flat, p95 +0.4%, error-rate unchanged. No 5xx spikes. Recommend proceed to 50%.

sam: Heads-up — session-cache cold-starts could inflate p95 for a bit. Suggest holding at 50% for 20m to let caches warm.

kevin: Good call. Hold at 50% for 20m. @deploy-bot set ramp-hold and annotate runbook.

deploy-bot: Ramp paused at 50% per request. Next auto-step delayed. Canary id cb-8421 in HOLD state.

samira: I see a small tokenization variance in ~0.4% of requests (examples attached in ticket #PLAT-712). Monitoring.

deploy-bot: 20m hold complete. Proceeding to 100% rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. feature/llmroute-v4 enabled for all traffic; v3 remains pinned for immediate rollback.

samira: After full rollout, p95 increased to +3.2% on specific endpoints (trace ids: t-991, t-1002). Escalating and flagging for rollback watch.

kevin: Pause rollout follow-ups. Initiate rollback to v3 and disable feature flag. deploy-bot: reroute traffic to pinned v3 and set feature/llmroute-v4 = OFF.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: unroute v4, switch traffic to v3, feature flag toggled OFF. Rollback complete. Confirming live traffic on v3.

maria: Verified — latency returned to baseline across affected endpoints. No lingering errors. Starting incident ticket for postmortem and trace collection.

kevin: Release notes snippet: "v4 small-batch rollout paused and rolled back due to increased p95 latency on subset of endpoints. feature/llmroute-v4 disabled; traffic pinned to v3. Next steps: collect traces, add regression tests for tokenization path, re-run small-batch with additional telemetry and longer soak."

maria: I'll own the post-deploy incident and coordinate repro + canary test enhancements. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
